Four of these were settled the same way on 16.09.2026 (537/1068/26, 542/1073/26, 544/1075/26, 547/1078/26). A reader that truncates a range loses the lower bound, which is the half that says the count is not zero.

parameter identification_a_macroscopic.note: Read B raised three identification rows out of the report's TITLE ('Идентификација и квантификација на канабиноиди во цвет од канабис'). The result table has three rows and they are the three cannabinoids: Вкупен Cannabidiol, Вкупен Cannabinol, Вкупно Δ9-Tetrahydrocannabinol. A title is not a determination. What this report does certify for #3 Identification C is the desk's own standing rule for a Farmahem cannabinoid report — the identity of the cannabinoid profile by HPLC, as its three sibling reports 031-2, 031-4 and 031-5-К/26 are already cited on their certificates — and that is a rule, not a reading of this page.
